160#define TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BIT 32
161
167#define TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_MAX 4
168
172#define TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_BIT TOMMY_ILOG2(TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_MAX)
173
177#define TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_BIT ((TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BIT % TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_BIT) + 3 * TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_BIT)
178
183#define TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_MAX (1 << TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_BIT)
184
188#define TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_MASK (TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_MAX - 1)
189
193#define TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_SHIFT (TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BIT - TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_BIT)
194
200#define TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_SHIFT (TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_SHIFT - TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_BIT)
201
206typedef struct tommy_trie_inplace_node_struct {
207 struct tommy_trie_inplace_node_struct* next;
208 struct tommy_trie_inplace_node_struct* prev;
209 void* data;
210 struct tommy_trie_inplace_node_struct* map[TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_MAX];
211 tommy_key_t key;
212} tommy_trie_inplace_node;
213
218typedef struct tommy_trie_inplace_struct {
219 tommy_trie_inplace_node* bucket[TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_MAX];
220 tommy_size_t count;
221} tommy_trie_inplace;

299tommy_inline tommy_trie_inplace_node* tommy_trie_inplace_bucket(tommy_trie_inplace* trie_inplace, tommy_key_t key)
300{
301 /* ensure that the element is not too big */
302 assert(key >> TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_SHIFT < TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_MAX);
303
304 tommy_trie_inplace_node* node = trie_inplace->bucket[key >> TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_BUCKET_SHIFT];
305 int shift = TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_SHIFT;
306
307 while (node && node->key != key) {
308 node = node->map[(key >> shift) & TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_MASK];
309 shift -= TOMMY_TRIE_INPLACE_TREE_BIT;
310 }
311
312 return node;
313}

335tommy_inline void* tommy_trie_inplace_search(tommy_trie_inplace* trie_inplace, tommy_key_t key)
336{
337 tommy_trie_inplace_node* i = tommy_trie_inplace_find(trie_inplace, key);

339 if (!i)
340 return 0;
341
342 return i->data;
343}
